title: Devon Witherspoon: Contract extension or not, I have to be prepared for the season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Devon Witherspoon: Contract extension or not, I have to be prepared for the season
sources.description: Cornerback Devon Witherspoon has not been able to come to an agreement on a contract extension with the Seahawks, but he hasn't let that impact his training camp participation this summer.
